procedural_matters: ?The race committee was represented by Malledant Anne (PRO).
FRA 441 was represented by Gaultier Tallieu (crew).
facts: At the start of race P5 of the 49er blue fleet, the conditions were 5 - 6 knots of wind with small chop.
Before the starting sequence, the pin end boat anchored and prepared for the starting sequence.
After the warning signal, FRA 441 sailed to starboard of the pin end boat and stopped.
At 4:05 to the start, the race committee member on the pin end boat added an extra weight to the anchor line.
Another 49er sailboat entered the space between FRA 441 and the pin end boat.
conclusions: The race committee did not move the starting mark after the preparatory signal as required by RRS 27.2
There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
